tech.summary: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash-1017 on 17 October, with open weights under an MIT licence, a 1-million-token context window, and API pricing from $0.15 per million input tokens. It scores 45 on the Artificial Analysis index, up from 39 for the September version. Separately, a US Homeland Security order made public on 19 October bars federal civilian agencies from DeepSeek products.
tech.title: DeepSeek's new Flash model is faster and cheaper — but US federal agencies must now remove it

tech.summary: OpenAI says researchers using its GPT-5.6 Sol model under its Patch the Planet initiative helped uncover two critical PHP vulnerabilities, dubbed PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), which allow unauthenticated remote code execution. PHP shipped fixes on 21 October in versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; security firm Wiz independently found both flaws.
tech.title: AI found the PHP flaws that could hit 70% of websites — patches are out

tech.summary: Adobe is pitching its AI graphics as commercially safe for business use, backing that claim with an indemnity promise if clients face legal action over the generated work. The pitch lands as brands weigh the copyright and legal risk of using AI-generated visuals in commercial campaigns.
tech.title: Adobe pushes 'commercially safe' AI graphics — and says it will indemnify clients if they get sued

tech.summary: SoftBank has completed the final phase of its $30 billion investment in OpenAI, part of the ChatGPT maker's last fundraising round. The Japanese group previously agreed to invest through three $10 billion tranches via Vision Fund 2; its cumulative investment in OpenAI now stands at $64.6 billion for a 13% stake.
tech.title: SoftBank completes its $30 billion investment in OpenAI

tech.summary: OpenAI published 722 manuscripts organised into 372 result families in a public GitHub repository, produced by an unreleased internal frontier model that was posed about 4,000 problems. Many results carry computer-checkable Lean proof formalisations, but not all do, and OpenAI cautions some unformalised results could have issues.
tech.title: OpenAI releases 722 AI-written math manuscripts from an unreleased frontier model

pakistan.summary: The PPP staged a protest rally in Lahore on Sunday against the LPG shortage and rising flour and fuel prices, warning of a sit-in outside Sui Northern Gas Pipelines' head office if gas outages continue. Lahore president Faisal Mir accused sellers of creating an artificial shortage and demanded uninterrupted supply at prices in line with people's purchasing power.
pakistan.title: PPP rallies against LPG shortage and rising flour, fuel prices

pakistan.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar met Chinese Ambassador Jiang Zaidong in Islamabad on Sunday to review China-Pakistan Economic Corridor progress, covering trade, investment, regional connectivity, agricultural modernisation and people-to-people exchanges. Both sides discussed accelerating CPEC's second phase, focused on industrialisation, technology and export-led growth.
pakistan.title: Dar, Chinese envoy review CPEC progress

pakistan.summary: Pakistan and Qatar held the second meeting of their Joint Task Force on Trade and Investment in Doha, co-chaired by Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan and Qatar's Minister of State for Foreign Trade Affairs. Talks covered agriculture, food security, manufacturing, IT, maritime transport and infrastructure, plus an early signing of the Pakistan-GCC free trade agreement.
pakistan.title: Pakistan, Qatar explore new avenues for trade, investment cooperation

pakistan.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has directed the enactment of the country's first royalty law for the film industry, with a rebate of 35% for Punjabi films and 20% for Urdu films made in the province. A Film City is set to be inaugurated in Lahore on 15 December, with a film school, museum, studios and Pakistan's largest convention centre.
pakistan.title: Punjab orders country's first film royalty law, approves rebate plan

pakistan.summary: Shadab Khan struck an unbeaten 113 and shared a record 89-run last-wicket stand with Haris Rauf as Pakistan rallied from 154-9 to beat England by one wicket in Lahore on Sunday and book a place in the tri-series final. England were bowled out for 241 despite Ben Duckett's 105; Shaheen Shah Afridi took 4-46.
pakistan.title: Shadab heroics lift Pakistan past England in one-wicket thriller

pakistan.summary: The PSX benchmark KSE-100 index fell 2.4% over the outgoing week, shedding 4,045 points to close at 162,375, as escalating geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices and domestic economic uncertainty weighed on sentiment. It was the index's fifth consecutive weekly decline, slipping below 166,000, 164,000 and 163,000.
pakistan.title: PSX down 4,045 points in a week amid Middle East tensions
